title: The Tin Drum
author: Günter Grass
summary: Oskar Matzerath decides at age three to stop growing and bangs a tin drum, with a scream that can shatter glass. He narrates from an asylum, telling of his family and Danzig before, during and after the Nazi era.
readIf: you like grotesque, satirical, inventive novels that treat history with dark humour.
skipIf: you prefer realism or are uneasy with a morally repellent narrator and disturbing scenes.
